question: Should OpenClaw add HEARTBEAT.md task-level model metadata, route heartbeat tasks through a broader scheduled-task model contract, or keep heartbeat routing whole-turn via plugins for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but automation should not choose the public HEARTBEAT.md syntax or split-versus-batched execution semantics because that affects model routing, provider auth, fallback behavior, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract
options.body: Define a reusable heartbeat/scheduled-task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only metadata
options.body: Add a narrow HEARTBEAT.md task model field with explicit split/group semantics and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep whole-turn plugin routing
options.body: Document before_model_resolve and community routing plugins as the supported model-routing path while leaving multiple due heartbeat tasks batched.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract
recommendation.body: Define a reusable heartbeat/scheduled-task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest product-scope signal for the core-versus-plugin model-routing boundary.
